decisions.choice: Halah, the Habor, Gozan and the cities of the Medes: places in the far north and east of the Assyrian empire
decisions.reason: Halah lay in Assyria, northeast of Nineveh. The Habor is a river that flows into the Euphrates, and Gozan was a city on it. Media lay further east in the mountains of what is now Iran. Assyria moved conquered peoples far from home so they could not rebel (17:24; Isaiah 36:17).

decisions.choice: the Israelites (Balanced); the people of Israel ... as captives (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say that "Israel" here means its people, and Readable explains "exiled" as being taken away as captives, in the wording of 17:6.

decisions.choice: "데려가 [살게 했다]", ending the sentence in verse 11
alternatives: running on into verse 12 with a comma
decisions.reason: The English Literal runs verse 11 into verse 12; Korean needs its verb at the end, so verse 11 closes and verse 12 begins with the reason ("그것은 ... 때문이다").

decisions.choice: os conduziu (L, B); os levou (R)
decisions.reason: The verse repeats 17:6 in the same Portuguese words, but where 17:6 says "os fez habitar" (L) and "os estabeleceu" (B), this verse has the verb "led" (m1), so Literal and Balanced say "conduziu", and Readable "levou".

decisions.choice: Halah "ハラ", Habor "ハボル", Gozan "ゴザン", the Medes "メディア人"
decisions.reason: Transcriptions of the Hebrew; Media in the usual Japanese form.

source.text: עַ֣ל׀אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־שָׁמְע֗וּ בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֔ם וַיַּעַבְרוּ֙ אֶת־בְּרִית֔וֹ אֵ֚ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֔ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֣בֶד יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ וְלֹ֥א עָשֽׂוּ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Because that not they listened to [the] voice of Yahweh their God, and they transgressed his covenant, all that had commanded Moses [the] servant of Yahweh; and not they listened and not they did.

en.L: because they did not listen to the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God, and they transgressed {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant, all that Moses the slave of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded; and they did not listen and did not do [it].
en.B: This happened because they did not obey the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God, but broke {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant, everything Moses the servant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded. They would neither listen nor do it.
en.R: This happened because they did not obey {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God. They broke {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant, everything that Moses, the servant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, had commanded them. They would not listen, and they would not obey.

es.L: porque no escucharon la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios, sino que quebrantaron {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto, todo lo que había mandado Moisés, siervo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; y no escucharon ni [lo] hicieron.
es.B: Esto sucedió porque no obedecieron la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios, sino que quebrantaron {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto, todo lo que Moisés, siervo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, había mandado. No quisieron escuchar ni cumplirlo.
es.R: Esto sucedió porque no obedecieron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} su Dios. Quebrantaron {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto, todo lo que Moisés, el siervo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, les había mandado. No quisieron escuchar ni obedecer.

fr.L: parce qu’ils n’avaient pas écouté la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} leur Dieu, et qu’ils avaient transgressé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance, tout ce qu’avait prescrit Moïse, l’esclave {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; ils n’avaient ni écouté ni pratiqué.
fr.B: Cela arriva parce qu’ils n’avaient pas obéi à la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} leur Dieu, mais avaient violé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance, tout ce que Moïse, le serviteur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, avait prescrit. Ils n’avaient voulu ni écouter ni obéir.
fr.R: Cela est arrivé parce qu’ils n’avaient pas obéi à {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu. Ils avaient violé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance, tout ce que Moïse, le serviteur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, leur avait ordonné. Ils n’avaient pas voulu écouter, et ils n’avaient pas voulu obéir.

sw.L: kwa sababu hawakuisikia sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao, bali walilivunja agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, yote aliyoyaamuru Musa mtumwa wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; wala hawakusikia, wala hawakuyafanya.
sw.B: Hayo yalitokea kwa sababu hawakuitii sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao, bali walilivunja agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, kila kitu alichoamuru Musa mtumishi wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hawakutaka kusikiliza wala kutenda.
sw.R: Hayo yalitokea kwa sababu hawakumtii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao. Walilivunja agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, kila kitu ambacho Musa, mtumishi wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, alikuwa amewaamuru. Hawakutaka kusikiliza, wala hawakutaka kutii.

vi.L: vì họ không nghe tiếng của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ, và vi phạm giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, mọi điều Môi-se, đầy tớ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã truyền; họ không nghe và không làm theo.
vi.B: Việc này xảy ra vì họ không vâng theo tiếng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ, nhưng vi phạm giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là mọi điều Môi-se, đầy tớ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã truyền. Họ không chịu nghe, cũng không chịu làm theo.
vi.R: Việc này xảy ra vì họ không vâng lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ. Họ vi phạm giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là mọi điều Môi-se, đầy tớ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã truyền cho họ. Họ không chịu nghe, và cũng không chịu vâng theo.

ko.L: [그것은] 그들이 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 목소리를 듣지 않고, 그분의 언약, 곧 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 종 모세가 명령한 모든 것을 어겼기 때문이다. 그들은 듣지도 않았고 행하지도 않았다.
ko.B: 이런 일이 일어난 것은 그들이 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 목소리에 순종하지 않고, 그분의 언약, 곧 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 종 모세가 명령한 모든 것을 어겼기 때문이다. 그들은 듣지도 않았고 행하지도 않았다.
ko.R: 이런 일이 일어난 것은 그들이 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 순종하지 않았기 때문이다. 그들은 그분의 언약, 곧 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 종 모세가 그들에게 명령한 모든 것을 어겼다. 그들은 듣지도 않았고 따르지도 않았다.

pt.L: porque não ouviram a voz {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o seu Deus, e transgrediram a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} aliança, tudo o que Moisés, escravo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, tinha ordenado; e não ouviram e não [o] fizeram.
pt.B: Isso aconteceu porque não obedeceram à voz {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o seu Deus, mas quebraram a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} aliança, tudo o que Moisés, o servo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, tinha ordenado. Não quiseram nem ouvir nem cumprir.
pt.R: Isso aconteceu porque eles não obedeceram {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o seu Deus. Quebraram a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} aliança, tudo o que Moisés, o servo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, lhes tinha ordenado. Não quiseram ouvir e não quiseram obedecer.

am.L: የአምላካቸውን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ድምፅ አልሰሙምና፤ ቃል ኪዳኑንም፣ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ባሪያ ሙሴ ያዘዘውን ሁሉ ተላለፉ፤ አልሰሙምም፤ አላደረጉምም።
am.B: ይህ የሆነው የአምላካቸውን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ድምፅ ስላልታዘዙ ነው፤ ቃል ኪዳኑን፣ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} አገልጋይ ሙሴ ያዘዘውን ሁሉ አፈረሱ። አልሰሙም፤ አላደረጉትምም።
am.R: ይህ የሆነው አምላካቸውን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ስላልታዘዙ ነው። ቃል ኪዳኑን አፈረሱ፤ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} አገልጋይ ሙሴ ያዘዛቸውን ሁሉ ጣሱ። አልሰሙም፤ አልታዘዙምም።

hi.L: क्योंकि उन्होंने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर की आवाज़ नहीं सुनी, और उनकी वाचा को, अर्थात् जो कुछ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के दास मूसा ने आज्ञा दी थी, उस सब को तोड़ा; और उन्होंने न सुना और न [उस पर] चले।
hi.B: यह इसलिए हुआ कि उन्होंने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर की बात नहीं मानी, बल्कि उनकी वाचा को, उस सब को जिसकी आज्ञा {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के दास मूसा ने दी थी, तोड़ दिया। उन्होंने न सुना और न उस पर चले।
hi.R: यह इसलिए हुआ कि उन्होंने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर की बात नहीं मानी। उन्होंने उनकी वाचा तोड़ दी, यानी वह सब जिसकी आज्ञा {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के दास मूसा ने उन्हें दी थी। उन्होंने न सुना और न माना।

ru.L: за то, что они не слушали голоса {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, своего Бога, и преступили {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} завет, всё, что заповедал Моисей, раб {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}; и не слушали, и не исполняли.
ru.B: Это случилось потому, что они не слушались голоса {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, своего Бога, а нарушили {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} завет, всё, что заповедал Моисей, раб {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. Они не хотели ни слушать, ни исполнять.
ru.R: Это случилось потому, что они не слушались {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, своего Бога. Они нарушили {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} завет, всё, что заповедал им Моисей, слуга {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. Они не хотели слушать и не хотели исполнять.

ja.L: それは、彼らが彼らの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の声に聞き従わず、その契約、すなわち{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の奴隷モーセが命じたすべてのことを破ったからである。彼らは聞かず、行わなかった。
ja.B: こうなったのは、彼らが自分たちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の声に聞き従わず、その契約、すなわち{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のしもべモーセが命じたすべてのことを破ったからである。彼らは聞こうとも、行おうともしなかった。
ja.R: こうなったのは、イスラエルの人々が、自分たちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に従わなかったからです。人々はその契約を破りました。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のしもべモーセが命じたことを、すべて破ったのです。人々は聞こうともせず、従おうともしませんでした。

uk.L: тому що вони не слухали голосу {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, свого Бога, і порушили {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} завіт, усе, що заповів Мойсей, раб {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}; і не слухали, і не виконували.
uk.B: Це сталося тому, що вони не слухалися голосу {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, свого Бога, а порушили {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} завіт, усе, що заповів Мойсей, слуга {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}. Вони не хотіли ні слухати, ні виконувати.
uk.R: Це сталося тому, що вони не слухалися {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, свого Бога. Вони порушили {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} завіт, усе, що заповів їм Мойсей, слуга {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}. Вони не хотіли слухати і не хотіли виконувати.

decisions.choice: did not listen to the voice of Yahweh: did not obey him
decisions.reason: To listen to someone's voice means to do what he says (Deuteronomy 28:15). The verse ends with the same verb: they did not listen and did not act.

decisions.choice: they broke his covenant: the reason for the exile
decisions.reason: The verse sums up the long explanation of 17:7-23. Israel's exile was not a mere defeat by a stronger power; it was the result the covenant had warned of (Deuteronomy 28:15, 36). The same words set Israel's failure against Hezekiah's faithfulness (verse 6).

decisions.choice: Moses the servant of Yahweh: the one who belonged to Yahweh and served him
decisions.reason: The word means a slave or servant, one who belongs to a master, not a hired worker. Used of Moses it is a title of honor: he belonged to Yahweh and spoke for him (Deuteronomy 34:5; Joshua 1:1).

decisions.choice: slave (Literal); servant (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As everywhere for "the servant of Yahweh", Literal says "slave" and Balanced and Readable "servant".

decisions.choice: This happened because
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sentence runs on from verse 11. Balanced and Readable start a new sentence and supply "This happened" so that the reason stands on its own.

decisions.choice: "siervo del SEÑOR"
decisions.reason: As the Psalms terms note sets for Spanish, "the servant of the LORD" is "siervo" at every level, Literal included.

decisions.choice: escravo do SENHOR (L); o servo do SENHOR (B, R)
decisions.reason: Moses' title (m3) is worded as Deuteronomy 34:5 has it in Portuguese: "escravo" at Literal, "servo" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के दास मूसा" at every level
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch note settles, ʿeved is "दास" at every level, as the New Testament does; for Moses it is a title of honour.

source.text: וּבְאַרְבַּע֩ עֶשְׂרֵ֨ה שָׁנָ֜ה לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ חִזְקִיָּ֗ה עָלָ֞ה סַנְחֵרִ֤יב מֶֽלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר֙ עַ֣ל כָּל־עָרֵ֧י יְהוּדָ֛ה הַבְּצֻר֖וֹת וַֽיִּתְפְּשֵֽׂם׃

records.literal_gloss: And in four-teen year of the king Hezekiah came up Sennacherib king of Assyria against all [the] cities of Judah the fortified, and seized them.

en.L: And in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah and seized them.
en.B: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria marched against all the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.
en.R: In the fourteenth year that Hezekiah was king, Sennacherib, the king of Assyria, attacked all the walled cities of Judah and captured them.

es.L: Y en el año catorce del rey Ezequías subió Senaquerib, rey de Asiria, contra todas las ciudades fortificadas de Judá, y las tomó.
es.B: En el año catorce del rey Ezequías, Senaquerib, rey de Asiria, marchó contra todas las ciudades fortificadas de Judá y las conquistó.
es.R: En el año catorce del reinado de Ezequías, Senaquerib, el rey de Asiria, atacó todas las ciudades amuralladas de Judá y las conquistó.

fr.L: Et en la quatorzième année du roi Ézéchias, Sennachérib, roi d’Assyrie, monta contre toutes les villes fortifiées de Juda et s’en empara.
fr.B: La quatorzième année du roi Ézéchias, Sennachérib, roi d’Assyrie, marcha contre toutes les villes fortifiées de Juda et s’en empara.
fr.R: La quatorzième année du règne d’Ézéchias, Sennachérib, le roi d’Assyrie, a attaqué toutes les villes fortifiées de Juda et il les a prises.

sw.L: Na katika mwaka wa kumi na nne wa mfalme Hezekia, Senakeribu mfalme wa Ashuru alipanda juu ya miji yote yenye ngome ya Yuda, akaiteka.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa kumi na nne wa mfalme Hezekia, Senakeribu mfalme wa Ashuru aliishambulia miji yote yenye ngome ya Yuda, akaiteka.
sw.R: Katika mwaka wa kumi na nne wa utawala wa Hezekia, Senakeribu, mfalme wa Ashuru, aliishambulia miji yote yenye kuta ya Yuda, akaiteka.

vi.L: Năm thứ mười bốn đời vua Ê-xê-chia, San-chê-ríp vua A-si-ri đi lên đánh mọi thành kiên cố của Giu-đa và chiếm lấy.

vi.R: Năm thứ mười bốn đời Ê-xê-chia làm vua, San-chê-ríp, vua A-si-ri, tấn công mọi thành có tường bao của Giu-đa và chiếm được các thành ấy.

pt.L: E no décimo quarto ano do rei Ezequias, Senaqueribe, rei da Assíria, subiu contra todas as cidades fortificadas de Judá e as tomou.
pt.B: No décimo quarto ano do rei Ezequias, Senaqueribe, rei da Assíria, marchou contra todas as cidades fortificadas de Judá e as conquistou.
pt.R: No décimo quarto ano em que Ezequias era rei, Senaqueribe, o rei da Assíria, atacou todas as cidades de Judá que tinham muralhas e as conquistou.

am.L: በንጉሡም በሕዝቅያስ በአሥራ አራተኛው ዓመት የአሦር ንጉሥ ሰናክሬም በተመሸጉት በይሁዳ ከተሞች ሁሉ ላይ ወጣ፤ ያዛቸውም።
am.B: ንጉሥ ሕዝቅያስ በነገሠ በአሥራ አራተኛው ዓመት የአሦር ንጉሥ ሰናክሬም በተመሸጉት የይሁዳ ከተሞች ሁሉ ላይ ዘምቶ ያዛቸው።

ru.L: И в четырнадцатый год царя Езекии поднялся Сеннахирим, царь Ассирии, на все укреплённые города Иуды и взял их.
ru.B: В четырнадцатый год царя Езекии Сеннахирим, царь Ассирии, выступил против всех укреплённых городов Иуды и захватил их.
ru.R: В четырнадцатый год царствования Езекии Сеннахирим, царь Ассирии, напал на все города Иуды, окружённые стенами, и захватил их.

ja.L: そしてヒゼキヤ王の第十四年に、アッシリアの王センナケリブが、ユダのすべての堅固な町々に攻め上って来て、それらを捕らえた。
ja.B: ヒゼキヤ王の治世第十四年に、アッシリアの王センナケリブが、ユダのすべての堅固な町々に攻め上って来て、それらを攻め取った。
ja.R: ヒゼキヤが王になって十四年目に、アッシリアの王センナケリブが、ユダの城壁のある町々をすべて攻めて、攻め落としました。

uk.L: А в чотирнадцятому році царя Єзекії піднявся Сеннахериб, цар Ассирії, на всі укріплені міста Юдеї і захопив їх.
uk.B: У чотирнадцятому році царя Єзекії Сеннахериб, цар Ассирії, вирушив проти всіх укріплених міст Юдеї і захопив їх.
uk.R: У чотирнадцятому році царювання Єзекії Сеннахериб, цар Ассирії, напав на всі міста Юдеї, оточені мурами, і захопив їх.

decisions.choice: the parallel account: Isaiah 36-39
decisions.reason: From here to 20:19 the story is told again in Isaiah 36-39, mostly in the same words. This verse matches Isaiah 36:1, except that Isaiah opens with "And it happened" and spells Hezekiah's name in its longer form. Verses 14-16, Hezekiah's payment to Sennacherib, have no parallel in Isaiah, which goes straight on to the officers' arrival at Jerusalem (verse 17; Isaiah 36:2).

decisions.choice: Sennacherib king of Assyria: his campaign against Judah in 701 BC
decisions.reason: Sennacherib ruled Assyria from 705 to 681 BC. After Hezekiah rebelled (verse 7), Sennacherib invaded Judah in 701 BC. His own annals claim that he took forty-six of Hezekiah's walled towns and shut Hezekiah up in Jerusalem "like a bird in a cage", and reliefs from his palace at Nineveh show the siege of Lachish (verses 14, 17). Jerusalem itself was not taken (19:32-36), so "all" means the walled towns of the land.

decisions.choice: the fourteenth year: dated from Hezekiah's accession
decisions.reason: If the campaign of 701 BC fell in Hezekiah's fourteenth year, his reign began about 715 BC; but verses 1 and 9-10 tie his early years to the last years of Samaria, before 722 BC. See the note at verse 1.

decisions.choice: walled cities
decisions.reason: Readable explains "fortified" as cities with walls, as in Isaiah 36:1.

decisions.choice: "Senaquerib"; drafted once for Isaiah 36
decisions.reason: "Senaquerib" as the terms note's table gives it. 2 Kings 18:13-20:19 is drafted here so that Isaiah 36-39 can reuse it, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: 2 Kings 18:13-20:19 drafted for reuse in Isaiah 36-39
decisions.reason: The terms note asks that this passage be drafted once here and reused for Isaiah, which has no French translation yet; the wording follows the Hebrew of Kings, and Isaiah will change only what its Hebrew changes.

decisions.choice: drafted once for 2 Kings 18:13-20:19 and Isaiah 36-39
decisions.reason: These chapters are Isaiah 36-39, which has no Vietnamese yet. The terms note asks for one draft here that Isaiah will reuse, so the wording follows the Hebrew of Kings and the English, which in turn follows Isaiah where the Hebrew agrees.

decisions.choice: 18:13-20:19 drafted once here as the Korean wording Isaiah 36-39 will reuse
decisions.reason: The terms note: Isaiah 36-39 has no Korean translation yet, so this passage is drafted here and Isaiah will reuse it, changing only where its Hebrew differs.

decisions.choice: Senaqueribe, rei da Assíria
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also chapter 19): the king (m2) takes the form of the shared list for Kings, "Senaqueribe", with the final "-e" Portuguese adds after a consonant.

decisions.choice: Sennacherib is "ሰናክሬም"; this chapter and the next set the Amharic wording that Isaiah 36-37 will follow.
decisions.reason: The terms list's form of the name; Isaiah 36-39 repeat 18:13-20:19 almost word for word, so the shared verses are drafted once.

decisions.choice: "सन्हेरीब" (Sennacherib); the wording of 18:13-20:19 drafted to serve also for Isaiah 36-39
decisions.reason: The history note settles the name. This account is repeated almost word for word in Isaiah 36-39, which is not yet drafted in Hindi; where the Hebrew is the same, Isaiah will reuse this wording at each level.

decisions.choice: Сеннахирим
decisions.reason: Sennacherib takes the traditional Russian Bible form the history note settles. This account (18:13-20:19) is told again in Isaiah 36-39 (m1); it is drafted here first, and Isaiah is to reuse this wording where the Hebrew is the same.

decisions.choice: Sennacherib "センナケリブ"
decisions.reason: The usual Japanese transcription; Isaiah 36-37 should use the same form.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח חִזְקִיָּ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֣ה אֶל־מֶֽלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר֩׀לָכִ֨ישָׁה׀לֵאמֹ֤ר׀חָטָ֨אתִי֙ שׁ֣וּב מֵֽעָלַ֔י אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־תִּתֵּ֥ן עָלַ֖י אֶשָּׂ֑א וַיָּ֨שֶׂם מֶֽלֶךְ־אַשּׁ֜וּר עַל־חִזְקִיָּ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֗ה שְׁלֹ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ כִּכַּר־כֶּ֔סֶף וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים כִּכַּ֥ר זָהָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent Hezekiah king of Judah to [the] king of Assyria to Lachish, saying, I have sinned; turn back from on me; that which you put on me I will bear. And imposed [the] king of Assyria on Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.

en.L: And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria at Lachish, saying, "I have sinned; turn back from me. Whatever you put on me I will bear." And the king of Assyria imposed on Hezekiah king of Judah 300 talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
en.B: Then Hezekiah king of Judah sent a message to Lachish, to the king of Assyria: "I have done wrong. Withdraw from me, and I will bear whatever you lay on me." The king of Assyria required Hezekiah king of Judah to pay {{units:about 11 tons of silver|300 talents of silver}} and {{units:about 2,250 pounds of gold|thirty talents of gold}}.
en.R: So Hezekiah king of Judah sent a message to the king of Assyria at Lachish. He said, "I was wrong to turn against you. Take your army away from me, and I will pay whatever you ask." The king of Assyria ordered Hezekiah to pay {{units:about 11 tons of silver|300 talents of silver}} and {{units:about 2,250 pounds of gold|thirty talents of gold}}.

es.L: Y Ezequías, rey de Judá, envió a decir al rey de Asiria a Laquis: «He pecado; retírate de mí; lo que me impongas, lo llevaré». Y el rey de Asiria impuso a Ezequías, rey de Judá, trescientos talentos de plata y treinta talentos de oro.
es.B: Entonces Ezequías, rey de Judá, le envió este mensaje al rey de Asiria, que estaba en Laquis: «He obrado mal. Retírate de mi tierra, y yo cargaré con lo que me impongas». El rey de Asiria le exigió a Ezequías, rey de Judá, que pagara {{units:unas 10 toneladas de plata|trescientos talentos de plata}} y {{units:unos 1 000 kilos de oro|treinta talentos de oro}}.
es.R: Así que Ezequías, rey de Judá, le envió un mensaje al rey de Asiria, que estaba en Laquis. Le dijo: «Hice mal en rebelarme contra ti. Retira tu ejército, y te pagaré lo que me pidas». El rey de Asiria le ordenó a Ezequías que pagara {{units:unas 10 toneladas de plata|trescientos talentos de plata}} y {{units:unos 1 000 kilos de oro|treinta talentos de oro}}.

fr.L: Et Ézéchias, roi de Juda, envoya [dire] au roi d’Assyrie, à Lakish : « J’ai péché ; retire-toi de moi. Ce que tu m’imposeras, je le porterai. » Et le roi d’Assyrie imposa à Ézéchias, roi de Juda, trois cents talents d’argent et trente talents d’or.
fr.B: Alors Ézéchias, roi de Juda, envoya ce message au roi d’Assyrie, à Lakish : « J’ai mal agi. Retire-toi de chez moi, et je supporterai tout ce que tu m’imposeras. » Le roi d’Assyrie exigea d’Ézéchias, roi de Juda, {{units:environ 10 tonnes d’argent|trois cents talents d’argent}} et {{units:environ une tonne d’or|trente talents d’or}}.
fr.R: Alors Ézéchias, roi de Juda, a envoyé un message au roi d’Assyrie, qui était à Lakish. Il lui a dit : « J’ai eu tort de me révolter contre toi. Retire ton armée de mon pays, et je paierai tout ce que tu demanderas. » Le roi d’Assyrie a obligé Ézéchias à payer {{units:environ 10 tonnes d’argent|trois cents talents d’argent}} et {{units:environ une tonne d’or|trente talents d’or}}.

sw.L: Naye Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda akatuma kwa mfalme wa Ashuru huko Lakishi, akisema, "Nimekosa; rudi kutoka kwangu. Lolote utakaloniwekea nitalibeba." Naye mfalme wa Ashuru akamtoza Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda talanta 300 za fedha na talanta thelathini za dhahabu.
sw.B: Kisha Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda alituma ujumbe huko Lakishi kwa mfalme wa Ashuru: "Nimekosa. Ondoka kwangu, nami nitabeba lolote utakaloniwekea." Mfalme wa Ashuru akamtaka Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda alipe {{units:karibu tani 10 za fedha|talanta 300 za fedha}} na {{units:karibu kilo 1,000 za dhahabu|talanta thelathini za dhahabu}}.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda alituma ujumbe kwa mfalme wa Ashuru huko Lakishi. Alisema, "Nilikosea kukuasi. Liondoe jeshi lako kwangu, nami nitalipa chochote utakachodai." Mfalme wa Ashuru akamwamuru Hezekia alipe {{units:karibu tani 10 za fedha|talanta 300 za fedha}} na {{units:karibu kilo 1,000 za dhahabu|talanta thelathini za dhahabu}}.

vi.L: Ê-xê-chia vua Giu-đa sai [người] đến vua A-si-ri tại La-ki, nói: "Tôi đã phạm lỗi; xin rút khỏi tôi. Điều gì vua đặt trên tôi, tôi sẽ gánh chịu." Vua A-si-ri đặt trên Ê-xê-chia vua Giu-đa ba trăm ta-lâng bạc và ba mươi ta-lâng vàng.
vi.B: Bấy giờ Ê-xê-chia vua Giu-đa sai người đến La-ki nói với vua A-si-ri: "Tôi đã làm điều sai. Xin rút quân khỏi đất tôi; vua đòi gì tôi cũng chịu." Vua A-si-ri buộc Ê-xê-chia vua Giu-đa phải nộp {{units:khoảng 10 tấn bạc|ba trăm ta-lâng bạc}} và {{units:khoảng 1 tấn vàng|ba mươi ta-lâng vàng}}.
vi.R: Vậy Ê-xê-chia vua Giu-đa sai người đem lời nhắn đến vua A-si-ri tại La-ki: "Tôi đã sai khi chống lại vua. Xin rút quân khỏi đất tôi, vua đòi bao nhiêu tôi cũng nộp." Vua A-si-ri buộc Ê-xê-chia nộp {{units:khoảng 10 tấn bạc|ba trăm ta-lâng bạc}} và {{units:khoảng 1 tấn vàng|ba mươi ta-lâng vàng}}.

ko.L: 그리고 유다 왕 히스기야가 라기스에 있는 앗시리아 왕에게 [사람을] 보내어 말했다. "제가 죄를 지었습니다. 저에게서 물러가 주십시오. 임금님께서 저에게 지우시는 것은 무엇이든지 제가 지겠습니다." 그러자 앗시리아 왕이 유다 왕 히스기야에게 은 삼백 달란트와 금 삼십 달란트를 물렸다.
ko.B: 그러자 유다 왕 히스기야가 라기스에 있는 앗시리아 왕에게 사람을 보내어 말했다. "제가 잘못했습니다. 저에게서 물러가 주십시오. 임금님께서 저에게 지우시는 것은 무엇이든지 감당하겠습니다." 앗시리아 왕은 유다 왕 히스기야에게 은 {{units:약 10톤|300달란트}}에다 금 {{units:약 1톤|삼십 달란트}}의 조공을 물렸다.
ko.R: 그래서 유다 왕 히스기야는 라기스에 있는 앗시리아 왕에게 사람을 보내어 말했다. "임금님을 배반한 것은 제 잘못이었습니다. 군대를 거두어 돌아가 주십시오. 무엇이든지 요구하시는 대로 바치겠습니다." 앗시리아 왕은 히스기야에게 은 {{units:약 10톤|300달란트}}에다 금 {{units:약 1톤|삼십 달란트}}까지 바치라고 명령했다.

pt.L: E Ezequias, rei de Judá, enviou ao rei da Assíria, em Laquis, dizendo: "Eu pequei; retire-se de mim. O que o senhor puser sobre mim eu suportarei." E o rei da Assíria impôs a Ezequias, rei de Judá, trezentos talentos de prata e trinta talentos de ouro.
pt.B: Então Ezequias, rei de Judá, mandou esta mensagem ao rei da Assíria, em Laquis: "Eu agi mal. Retire-se do meu território, e eu suportarei o que o senhor me impuser." O rei da Assíria exigiu que Ezequias, rei de Judá, pagasse {{units:cerca de 10 toneladas de prata|trezentos talentos de prata}} e {{units:cerca de 1.000 quilos de ouro|trinta talentos de ouro}}.
pt.R: Por isso Ezequias, rei de Judá, mandou uma mensagem ao rei da Assíria, em Laquis. Ele disse: "Eu errei quando me voltei contra o senhor. Tire o seu exército da minha terra, e eu pagarei o que o senhor pedir." O rei da Assíria mandou Ezequias pagar {{units:cerca de 10 toneladas de prata|trezentos talentos de prata}} e {{units:cerca de 1.000 quilos de ouro|trinta talentos de ouro}}.

am.L: የይሁዳም ንጉሥ ሕዝቅያስ ወደ አሦር ንጉሥ ወደ ለኪሶ እንዲህ ብሎ ላከ፦ «በድያለሁ፤ ከእኔ ተመለስ፤ የምትጭንብኝን እሸከማለሁ።» የአሦርም ንጉሥ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሕዝቅያስ ላይ 300 መክሊት ብርና ሠላሳ መክሊት ወርቅ ጣለበት።
am.B: ከዚያም የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሕዝቅያስ ወደ ለኪሶ ወደ አሦር ንጉሥ እንዲህ የሚል መልእክት ላከ፦ «በድያለሁ፤ ከእኔ ተመለስ፤ የምትጭንብኝንም ሁሉ እሸከማለሁ።» የአሦር ንጉሥም የይሁዳን ንጉሥ ሕዝቅያስን {{units:10,000 ኪሎ ያህል ብርና|300 መክሊት ብርና}} {{units:1,000 ኪሎ ያህል ወርቅ|ሠላሳ መክሊት ወርቅ}} እንዲከፍል አዘዘው።
am.R: ስለዚህ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሕዝቅያስ በለኪሶ ወደ ነበረው ወደ አሦር ንጉሥ መልእክት ላከ። እንዲህም አለ፦ «በአንተ ላይ በመነሣቴ በድያለሁ። ሠራዊትህን ከአገሬ መልስ፤ የምትጠይቀኝንም ሁሉ እከፍላለሁ።» የአሦር ንጉሥም ሕዝቅያስን {{units:10,000 ኪሎ ያህል ብርና|300 መክሊት ብርና}} {{units:1,000 ኪሎ ያህል ወርቅ|ሠላሳ መክሊት ወርቅ}} እንዲከፍል አዘዘው።

hi.L: और यहूदा के राजा हिजकिय्याह ने अश्शूर के राजा के पास लाकीश को यह कहला भेजा, "मुझसे पाप हुआ है; मेरे पास से लौट जाइए। जो कुछ आप मुझ पर डालेंगे, मैं उठाऊँगा।" और अश्शूर के राजा ने यहूदा के राजा हिजकिय्याह पर तीन सौ तालन्त चाँदी और तीस तालन्त सोना ठहराया।
hi.B: तब यहूदा के राजा हिजकिय्याह ने लाकीश में अश्शूर के राजा को यह संदेश भेजा: "मुझसे अपराध हुआ है। मेरे देश से लौट जाइए, और जो कुछ आप मुझ पर डालेंगे, मैं उठाऊँगा।" अश्शूर के राजा ने यहूदा के राजा हिजकिय्याह पर {{units:लगभग 10 टन चाँदी|तीन सौ तालन्त चाँदी}} और {{units:लगभग 1,000 किलो सोना|तीस तालन्त सोना}} देने का भार डाला।
hi.R: इसलिए यहूदा के राजा हिजकिय्याह ने लाकीश में अश्शूर के राजा के पास संदेश भेजा। उसने कहा, "आपके विरुद्ध विद्रोह करके मैंने ग़लती की। अपनी सेना मेरे देश से हटा लीजिए, और आप जो भी माँगेंगे, मैं दूँगा।" अश्शूर के राजा ने हिजकिय्याह से {{units:लगभग 10 टन चाँदी|तीन सौ तालन्त चाँदी}} और {{units:लगभग 1,000 किलो सोना|तीस तालन्त सोना}} माँगा।

ru.L: И послал Езекия, царь Иуды, к царю Ассирии в Лахис сказать: «Я согрешил; отступи от меня. Что наложишь на меня, понесу.» И наложил царь Ассирии на Езекию, царя Иуды, триста талантов серебра и тридцать талантов золота.
ru.B: Тогда Езекия, царь Иуды, отправил в Лахис к царю Ассирии такое послание: «Я поступил неправильно. Отступи от меня, и я понесу всё, что ты на меня наложишь.» И царь Ассирии потребовал от Езекии, царя Иуды, {{units:около 10 тонн серебра|триста талантов серебра}} и {{units:около тонны золота|тридцать талантов золота}}.
ru.R: Тогда Езекия, царь Иуды, отправил к царю Ассирии в Лахис послание: «Я поступил неправильно, когда восстал против тебя. Уведи от меня своё войско, и я заплачу, сколько ты скажешь.» И царь Ассирии приказал Езекии заплатить {{units:около 10 тонн серебра|триста талантов серебра}} и {{units:около тонны золота|тридцать талантов золота}}.

ja.L: そしてユダの王ヒゼキヤは、ラキシュにいるアッシリアの王に人を遣わして言った。「わたしは罪を犯しました。わたしのところから引き返してください。あなたがわたしに課すものは何でも負います。」そしてアッシリアの王は、ユダの王ヒゼキヤに銀三百キカルと金三十キカルを課した。
ja.B: そこでユダの王ヒゼキヤは、ラキシュにいるアッシリアの王に使いを送って言った。「わたしは過ちを犯しました。わたしのところから軍を引き揚げてください。あなたが課されるものは何でも負います。」アッシリアの王は、ユダの王ヒゼキヤに、{{units:銀約10トン|銀三百キカル}}と{{units:金約1トン|金三十キカル}}を納めるよう命じた。
ja.R: そこで、ユダの王ヒゼキヤは、ラキシュにいるアッシリアの王に使いを送って言いました。「あなたに逆らったのは、わたしのまちがいでした。軍隊を引き揚げてください。お求めになるものは、何でもお払いします。」アッシリアの王はヒゼキヤに、{{units:銀約10トン|銀三百キカル}}と{{units:金約1トン|金三十キカル}}を払うよう命じました。

uk.L: І послав Єзекія, цар Юдеї, до царя Ассирії в Лахіш, кажучи: «Я згрішив; відступи від мене. Що ти накладеш на мене, те понесу». І наклав цар Ассирії на Єзекію, царя Юдеї, триста талантів срібла і тридцять талантів золота.
uk.B: Тоді Єзекія, цар Юдеї, послав до Лахіша, до царя Ассирії, таку вістку: «Я вчинив неправо. Відступи від мене, і я понесу все, що ти накладеш на мене». Цар Ассирії зажадав від Єзекії, царя Юдеї, {{units:близько 10 тонн срібла|300 талантів срібла}} і {{units:близько тонни золота|тридцять талантів золота}}.
uk.R: Тож Єзекія, цар Юдеї, послав вістку цареві Ассирії в Лахіш. Він сказав: «Я помилився, що повстав проти тебе. Відведи від мене своє військо, і я заплачу все, що ти скажеш». Цар Ассирії наказав Єзекії заплатити {{units:близько 10 тонн срібла|300 талантів срібла}} і {{units:близько тонни золота|тридцять талантів золота}}.

decisions.choice: verses 14-16: not in Isaiah
decisions.reason: Isaiah's account (Isaiah 36:1-2) passes over Hezekiah's surrender and payment and goes straight from the fall of Judah's towns to the officers' arrival at Jerusalem. Kings tells it, and so shows that paying did not stop the invasion: Sennacherib took the silver and gold and still sent his army against Jerusalem (verse 17).

decisions.choice: I have sinned: I have wronged you by breaking our treaty
decisions.reason: The verb means to miss the mark, to do wrong. Here a vassal king speaks to his overlord: Hezekiah admits that his rebellion (verse 7) broke his duty to Assyria. It is a confession of political wrong, not of sin against Yahweh.

decisions.choice: turn back from me: withdraw your army from my land
decisions.reason: The phrase "turn back from on me" asks the king to take away the weight of his army that lies on Judah.

decisions.choice: three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold: a huge tribute
decisions.reason: A talent was the largest weight, about 75 pounds. Sennacherib's own annals record that Hezekiah sent him thirty talents of gold and eight hundred talents of silver, with much else; the gold matches, and the silver may have been counted by a different standard or with other goods added.

decisions.choice: about 11 tons of silver; about 2,250 pounds of gold
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the weight in modern measures, with the talents as the alternative. Literal keeps the Hebrew units.

decisions.choice: I was wrong to turn against you
decisions.reason: Readable says what Hezekiah's wrong was: his rebellion against the Assyrian king (m2).

decisions.choice: {{units:unas 10 toneladas de plata|trescientos talentos de plata}}; {{units:unos 1 000 kilos de oro|treinta talentos de oro}}
decisions.reason: The talent at 34 kg, as the terms notes set, rounded as the English rounds; Literal keeps the talents, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "environ 10 tonnes d'argent" / "trois cents talents d'argent"; "environ une tonne d'or" / "trente talents d'or"
decisions.reason: The talent at 34 kg gives about 10 tonnes of silver and about one tonne of gold, where the English converts to US tons and pounds.

decisions.choice: {{units:karibu tani 10 za fedha|talanta 300 za fedha}}; {{units:karibu kilo 1,000 za dhahabu|talanta thelathini za dhahabu}}
decisions.reason: Metric by default at 34 kg to the talent (10,200 kg and 1,020 kg, rounded), with the talents as the alternative; the English gives US tons and pounds.

decisions.choice: king to king: tôi / vua
decisions.reason: Hezekiah writes to the Assyrian king as one king to another who now submits: "tôi" for himself and "vua" for his overlord, not the court's "bệ hạ".

decisions.choice: {{units:khoảng 10 tấn bạc|ba trăm ta-lâng bạc}}; {{units:khoảng 1 tấn vàng|ba mươi ta-lâng vàng}}
decisions.reason: Metric by default with the talent at 34 kg (300 talents are about 10.2 tonnes, thirty about 1 tonne), the original unit as the alternative.

decisions.choice: units spans "약 10톤" / "삼백 달란트" and "약 1톤" / "삼십 달란트", joined by "에다"
decisions.reason: Metric with a talent of 34 kg (10,200 kg and 1,020 kg, rounded), as the terms note fixes. The spans are joined by "에다" and followed by "의" or "까지", so one particle fits both wordings; Literal keeps the talents.

decisions.choice: Hezekiah writes to the king of Assyria in the formal style (합쇼체) with "임금님" and "저"
decisions.reason: A vassal suing for peace with his overlord; the speech level carries the submission, as Ahaz's message in 16:7.

decisions.choice: Laquis; o senhor (Hezekiah to the king of Assyria); Eu pequei (L), Eu agi mal (B), Eu errei (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the town (m1) is "Laquis", as Joshua 10 writes it in Portuguese. Hezekiah writes as a subject king to his overlord, so he says "o senhor", as Ahaz does in 16:7. "Pequei" at Literal keeps the Hebrew verb; Balanced and Readable say "agi mal" and "errei", since the wrong is his broken treaty, not a sin against God (m2).

decisions.choice: {{units:cerca de 10 toneladas de prata|trezentos talentos de prata}}, {{units:cerca de 1.000 quilos de ouro|trinta talentos de ouro}}
decisions.reason: As 5:5 sets it for this book: metric by default, with the Hebrew units as the alternative, reckoning a talent at 34 kilograms, as the Old Testament terms do; the English gives the same weights in tons and pounds. Literal keeps the talents, with the round numbers in words.

decisions.choice: Hezekiah writes to the king of Assyria with "አንተ" ("ተመለስ", "የምትጭንብኝን").
decisions.reason: A king writes to a king; the Hebrew's message is short and plain, and Hezekiah speaks of himself without the courtly "your servant".

decisions.choice: Units: 300 talents of silver are {{units:10,000 ኪሎ ያህል ብርና|300 መክሊት ብርና}}, thirty talents of gold {{units:1,000 ኪሎ ያህል ወርቅ|ሠላሳ መክሊት ወርቅ}}; Literal keeps the talents.
decisions.reason: Metric by default, the original weight as the alternative; a talent is about 34 kilograms, rounded here as the English rounds its figures.

decisions.choice: metric by default: "{{units:लगभग 10 टन चाँदी|तीन सौ तालन्त चाँदी}}", "{{units:लगभग 1,000 किलो सोना|तीस तालन्त सोना}}"
alternatives: "लगभग 11 टन" and "लगभग 2,250 पाउंड", as the English
decisions.reason: Hindi gives metric measures by default with the original unit as the setting, at 34 kg a talent (10,200 kg and 1,020 kg, rounded). Literal keeps the talents.

decisions.choice: Hezekiah says "आप" to the king of Assyria
decisions.reason: A subject king suing for peace addresses his overlord with "आप"; the Assyrians, in their message, speak to Hezekiah with the plain "तुम".

decisions.choice: около 10 тонн серебра / триста талантов серебра; около тонны золота / тридцать талантов золота
decisions.reason: The English converts to US tons and pounds; Russian converts to metric tonnes by default (a talent of about 34 kg), with the talents as the alternative. Literal keeps the talents.

decisions.choice: Я согрешил (L); Я поступил неправильно (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the ordinary word for sinning, here against an overlord by breaking a treaty (m2); Literal keeps "согрешил", and Balanced and Readable say it plainly, since no sin against God is meant.

decisions.choice: Metric default with the talent as the alternative: "銀約10トン" / "金約1トン" (1 kikkar ≈ 34 kg)
decisions.reason: Japanese settings give metric by default (style §7); the English gives US tons and pounds.

decisions.choice: Hezekiah to the king of Assyria in です・ます
decisions.reason: A vassal suing for terms speaks humbly.

decisions.choice: "близько 10 тонн срібла" and "близько тонни золота" by default, "300 талантів" and "тридцять талантів" with the units setting
decisions.reason: At 34 kg a talent, as through the book, 300 talents are about 10 tonnes and 30 talents about one; round figures suit amounts that are themselves round.

source.text: וַיִּתֵּן֙ חִזְקִיָּ֔ה אֶת־כָּל־הַכֶּ֖סֶף הַנִּמְצָ֣א בֵית־יְהוָ֑ה וּבְאֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And gave Hezekiah all the silver found [in the] house of Yahweh and in [the] treasuries of [the] house of the king.

en.L: And Hezekiah gave all the silver that was found [in the] house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and in the treasuries of the house of the king.
en.B: Hezekiah handed over to him all the silver to be found in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s house and in the treasuries of the king's palace.
en.R: Hezekiah gave him all the silver that could be found in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple and in the storerooms of the palace.

es.L: Y Ezequías dio toda la plata que se halló [en la] casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y en los tesoros de la casa del rey.
es.B: Ezequías le entregó toda la plata que había en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y en los tesoros del palacio real.
es.R: Ezequías le dio toda la plata que pudo encontrar en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y en los depósitos del palacio.

fr.L: Et Ézéchias donna tout l’argent qui se trouvait [dans] la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et dans les trésors de la maison du roi.
fr.B: Ézéchias lui livra tout l’argent qui se trouvait dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et dans les trésors du palais royal.
fr.R: Ézéchias lui a donné tout l’argent qu’on a pu trouver dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et dans les salles du trésor du palais.

sw.L: Naye Hezekia akatoa fedha yote iliyoonekana [katika] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na katika hazina za nyumba ya mfalme.
sw.B: Hezekia alimkabidhi fedha yote iliyopatikana katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na katika hazina za ikulu.
sw.R: Hezekia alimpa fedha yote iliyoweza kupatikana katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na katika vyumba vya hazina vya jumba la mfalme.

vi.L: Ê-xê-chia nộp hết bạc tìm thấy [trong] nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và trong các kho báu của cung vua.
vi.B: Ê-xê-chia nộp cho vua ấy hết số bạc có trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và trong kho báu hoàng cung.
vi.R: Ê-xê-chia nộp cho vua ấy hết số bạc có trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và trong các kho của hoàng cung.

ko.L: 그리고 히스기야가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집과 왕의 집 보물 창고들에서 발견된 모든 은을 주었다.
ko.B: 히스기야는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집과 왕궁 보물 창고에 있던 은을 모두 그에게 넘겨주었다.
ko.R: 히스기야는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전과 왕궁 창고에서 찾을 수 있는 은을 모두 그에게 주었다.

pt.L: E Ezequias deu toda a prata que se achava [na] casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e nos tesouros da casa do rei.
pt.B: Ezequias lhe entregou toda a prata que havia na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e nos tesouros do palácio real.
pt.R: Ezequias deu a ele toda a prata que pôde encontrar no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e nas salas do tesouro do palácio.

am.L: ሕዝቅያስም {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤትና በንጉሡ ቤት ግምጃ ቤቶች የተገኘውን ብር ሁሉ ሰጠ።
am.B: ሕዝቅያስ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስና በቤተ መንግሥቱ ግምጃ ቤቶች የተገኘውን ብር ሁሉ ሰጠው።
am.R: ሕዝቅያስ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስና በቤተ መንግሥቱ ዕቃ ቤቶች ሊገኝ የቻለውን ብር ሁሉ ሰጠው።

hi.L: और हिजकिय्याह ने वह सारी चाँदी दे दी जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन में और राजा के भवन के भंडारों में पाई गई।
hi.B: हिजकिय्याह ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन और राजमहल के भंडारों में मिली सारी चाँदी उसे सौंप दी।
hi.R: हिजकिय्याह ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के मन्दिर में और महल के भंडारों में मिली सारी चाँदी उसे दे दी।

ru.L: И отдал Езекия всё серебро, найденное [в] доме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и в сокровищницах дома царя.
ru.B: Езекия отдал ему всё серебро, какое нашлось в доме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и в сокровищницах царского дворца.
ru.R: Езекия отдал ему всё серебро, какое смог найти в храме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и в кладовых дворца.

ja.L: そしてヒゼキヤは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家と王の家の宝物倉にあったすべての銀を与えた。
ja.B: ヒゼキヤは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家と王宮の宝物倉にあった銀を、すべて彼に渡した。
ja.R: ヒゼキヤは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の神殿と王宮の倉にあった銀を、すべて王に渡しました。

uk.L: І віддав Єзекія все срібло, яке знайшлося [в] домі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} і в скарбницях царського дому.
uk.B: Єзекія віддав йому все срібло, яке знайшлося в домі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} і в скарбницях царського палацу.
uk.R: Єзекія віддав йому все срібло, яке тільки можна було знайти в храмі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} і в коморах палацу.

decisions.choice: all the silver in the temple and the palace: the treasuries emptied to buy off an enemy
decisions.reason: Kings of Judah had done this before: Asa to buy help from Aram (1 Kings 15:18), Joash to turn away Hazael (12:19), and Ahaz to win Assyria's help (16:8). The king who trusted Yahweh (verse 5) now pays from Yahweh's own house.

decisions.choice: gave him
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "him", the king of Assyria, to whom the silver was given (verse 14).

decisions.choice: the LORD's house (Balanced); the LORD's temple, storerooms (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps "house"; Readable says "temple" for the house of Yahweh and "storerooms" for treasuries.

decisions.choice: "the house of the LORD" is "{{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቤት" (L), "... ቤተ መቅደስ" (B, R); the king's house is "የንጉሡ ቤት" (L), "ቤተ መንግሥት" (B, R); treasuries "ግምጃ ቤቶች".
decisions.reason: The terms list's wording for the temple.

source.text: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֗יא קִצַּ֨ץ חִזְקִיָּ֜ה אֶת־דַּלְת֨וֹת הֵיכַ֤ל יְהוָה֙ וְאֶת־הָאֹ֣מְנ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִפָּ֔ה חִזְקִיָּ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖ם לְמֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃פ

records.literal_gloss: At the time the that stripped Hezekiah the doors of [the] temple of Yahweh and the doorposts which had overlaid Hezekiah king of Judah, and he gave them to [the] king of Assyria.

en.L: At that time Hezekiah stripped the doors of the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and the doorposts that Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and he gave them to the king of Assyria.
en.B: At that time Hezekiah stripped the gold from the doors of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple and from the doorposts that he, Hezekiah king of Judah, had covered with it, and gave it to the king of Assyria.
en.R: At that time Hezekiah also stripped the gold from the doors and doorposts of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple. He himself had covered them with gold. He gave the gold to the king of Assyria.

es.L: En aquel tiempo Ezequías despojó las puertas del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y los postes que Ezequías, rey de Judá, había recubierto, y los dio al rey de Asiria.
es.B: En aquel tiempo Ezequías arrancó el oro de las puertas del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y de los postes que él mismo, Ezequías, rey de Judá, había recubierto, y se lo dio al rey de Asiria.
es.R: En aquel tiempo Ezequías también arrancó el oro de las puertas y de los postes del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Él mismo los había recubierto de oro. Le dio ese oro al rey de Asiria.

fr.L: En ce temps-là, Ézéchias dépouilla les portes du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et les montants qu’Ézéchias, roi de Juda, avait plaqués, et il les donna au roi d’Assyrie.
fr.B: En ce temps-là, Ézéchias arracha l’or des portes du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et des montants que lui-même, Ézéchias, roi de Juda, en avait recouverts, et il le donna au roi d’Assyrie.
fr.R: À ce moment-là, Ézéchias a aussi arraché l’or des portes et des montants des portes du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. C’est lui-même qui les avait recouverts d’or. Il a donné cet or au roi d’Assyrie.

sw.L: Wakati huo Hezekia akaibandua milango ya hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na miimo ambayo Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda alikuwa ameifunika, akampa mfalme wa Ashuru.
sw.B: Wakati huo Hezekia aliibandua dhahabu kutoka kwenye milango ya hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kwenye miimo ambayo yeye, Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda, alikuwa ameifunika kwa dhahabu hiyo, akampa mfalme wa Ashuru.
sw.R: Wakati huo Hezekia aliibandua pia dhahabu kutoka kwenye milango na miimo ya hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Yeye mwenyewe ndiye aliyekuwa ameifunika kwa dhahabu. Akampa mfalme wa Ashuru dhahabu hiyo.

vi.L: Lúc ấy Ê-xê-chia lột các cánh cửa của đền thờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và các khung cửa mà Ê-xê-chia vua Giu-đa đã bọc, và nộp chúng cho vua A-si-ri.
vi.B: Lúc ấy Ê-xê-chia lột vàng khỏi các cánh cửa của đền thờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và các khung cửa mà chính Ê-xê-chia vua Giu-đa đã bọc vàng, rồi nộp cho vua A-si-ri.
vi.R: Lúc ấy Ê-xê-chia còn lột vàng khỏi các cánh cửa và khung cửa của đền thờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Chính ông đã bọc vàng các cửa ấy. Ông nộp số vàng ấy cho vua A-si-ri.

ko.L: 그때에 히스기야가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 문들과, 유다 왕 히스기야가 입혔던 문설주들을 벗겨 내어, 그것들을 앗시리아 왕에게 주었다.
ko.B: 그때에 히스기야는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 문들과, 유다 왕 히스기야 자신이 금을 입혔던 문설주들에서 금을 벗겨 내어 앗시리아 왕에게 주었다.
ko.R: 그때에 히스기야는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 문들과 문설주들에 입힌 금도 벗겨 냈다. 그 금은 전에 히스기야 자신이 입힌 것이었다. 그는 그 금을 앗시리아 왕에게 주었다.

pt.L: Naquele tempo Ezequias despojou as portas do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e os batentes que Ezequias, rei de Judá, tinha revestido, e os deu ao rei da Assíria.
pt.B: Naquele tempo, Ezequias arrancou o ouro das portas do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e dos batentes que ele mesmo, Ezequias, rei de Judá, tinha revestido, e entregou esse ouro ao rei da Assíria.
pt.R: Naquele tempo, Ezequias também arrancou o ouro das portas e dos batentes do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Ele mesmo os tinha coberto de ouro. Ele deu o ouro ao rei da Assíria.

am.L: በዚያን ጊዜ ሕዝቅያስ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} መቅደስ በሮችና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሕዝቅያስ የለበጣቸውን መቃኖች ገፈፈ፤ ለአሦርም ንጉሥ ሰጣቸው።
am.B: በዚያን ጊዜ ሕዝቅያስ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ በሮችንና እርሱ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሕዝቅያስ በወርቅ የለበጣቸውን መቃኖች ወርቃቸውን ገፎ ለአሦር ንጉሥ ሰጠ።
am.R: በዚያን ጊዜ ሕዝቅያስ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ በሮችና መቃኖች ላይ የነበረውን ወርቅ ገፈፈ። ራሱ ነበረ በወርቅ የለበጣቸው። ወርቁንም ለአሦር ንጉሥ ሰጠ።

hi.L: उस समय हिजकिय्याह ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के मन्दिर के दरवाज़ों को और उन चौखटों को, जिन पर यहूदा के राजा हिजकिय्याह ने [सोना] मढ़ा था, उतार लिया, और उन्हें अश्शूर के राजा को दे दिया।
hi.B: उस समय हिजकिय्याह ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के मन्दिर के दरवाज़ों और चौखटों पर से वह सोना उतरवा लिया जो उसने, यहूदा के राजा हिजकिय्याह ने, उन पर मढ़वाया था, और उसे अश्शूर के राजा को दे दिया।
hi.R: उस समय हिजकिय्याह ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के मन्दिर के दरवाज़ों और चौखटों पर से सोना भी उतरवा लिया। उसने ख़ुद ही उन पर सोना मढ़वाया था। उसने वह सोना अश्शूर के राजा को दे दिया।

ru.L: В то время ободрал Езекия двери храма {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и косяки, которые обложил Езекия, царь Иуды, и отдал их царю Ассирии.
ru.B: В то время Езекия снял золото с дверей храма {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и с косяков, которые он сам, Езекия, царь Иуды, обложил им, и отдал его царю Ассирии.
ru.R: В то время Езекия ещё и снял золото с дверей и косяков храма {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. Он сам когда-то покрыл их золотом. Это золото он отдал царю Ассирии.

ja.L: その時、ヒゼキヤは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の神殿の扉と、ユダの王ヒゼキヤがかぶせた戸柱とを、はぎ取り、それらをアッシリアの王に与えた。
ja.B: そのころ、ヒゼキヤは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の神殿の扉と、ユダの王ヒゼキヤ自身が金をかぶせた戸柱から、その金をはぎ取り、アッシリアの王に渡した。
ja.R: このときヒゼキヤは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の神殿の扉と戸柱から、金をはぎ取りました。それは、ヒゼキヤ自身が金をはったものでした。ヒゼキヤは、その金をアッシリアの王に渡しました。

uk.L: Того часу обдер Єзекія двері храму {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} і одвірки, які обклав Єзекія, цар Юдеї, і віддав їх цареві Ассирії.
uk.B: Того часу Єзекія обдер золото з дверей храму {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} і з одвірків, які він сам, Єзекія, цар Юдеї, ним обклав, і віддав його цареві Ассирії.
uk.R: Того часу Єзекія також обдер золото з дверей і одвірків храму {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}. Він сам колись обклав їх золотом. Тепер він віддав це золото цареві Ассирії.

decisions.choice: stripped ... overlaid: cut off the gold covering
decisions.reason: The first verb means to cut off or cut into pieces; the second, to overlay a surface with metal. Together they show what was taken: the gold plating on the doors, which Hezekiah cut away to make up the tribute of gold (verse 14). Solomon had overlaid the temple doors with gold (1 Kings 6:32, 35).

decisions.choice: doorposts: the supports of the doors
decisions.reason: The word is found only here. It comes from a root meaning firm or steady, and most likely names the posts or frames that held the doors.

decisions.choice: that Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid: he undid his own work
decisions.reason: The verse names Hezekiah twice: the gold he now strips off is gold he had put there himself, perhaps when he restored the temple at the start of his reign (2 Chronicles 29:3). The note is sad: the reforming king takes apart his own gift to Yahweh's house.

decisions.choice: the gold ... covered with it ... gave it
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the gold, which the verbs imply, so that it is clear what was given; Literal keeps "gave them".

decisions.choice: "el oro"
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the gold, which the verbs imply, so it is clear what was given (m1); Literal keeps the bare verbs.

decisions.choice: "le temple du SEIGNEUR" at every level
decisions.reason: Here the Hebrew has the word for the temple building (*hekhal*), not "house", so French says "temple" at Literal and Balanced too, as the English does.

decisions.choice: hekalu la BWANA at every level
decisions.reason: Here the Hebrew word is "temple" (*hekhal*), not "house", so every level says "hekalu", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का मन्दिर" where the Hebrew has hekhal
decisions.reason: The history note keeps "मन्दिर" for the temple building (hekhal), distinct from "भवन" for the house of the LORD; here the Hebrew has the temple word.

decisions.choice: храм
decisions.reason: Here the Hebrew word is "hekhal", the temple hall, not "the house", and every level says "храм", as the history note settles.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח מֶֽלֶךְ־אַשּׁ֡וּר אֶת־תַּרְתָּ֥ן וְאֶת־רַב־סָרִ֣יס׀וְאֶת־רַב־שָׁקֵ֨ה מִן־לָכִ֜ישׁ אֶל־הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ חִזְקִיָּ֛הוּ בְּחֵ֥יל כָּבֵ֖ד יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַֽיַּעֲלוּ֙ וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַיַּעֲל֣וּ וַיָּבֹ֗אוּ וַיַּֽעַמְדוּ֙ בִּתְעָלַת֙ הַבְּרֵכָ֣ה הָֽעֶלְיוֹנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֕ר בִּמְסִלַּ֖ת שְׂדֵ֥ה כוֹבֵֽס׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent [the] king of Assyria [the] Tartan and [the] Rab-saris and [the] Rabshakeh from Lachish to the king Hezekiah with an army heavy, Jerusalem; and they went up and came [to] Jerusalem; and they went up and came and stood at [the] conduit of the pool the upper, which [is] on [the] highway of [the] field of [the] washer.

en.L: And the king of Assyria sent the Tartan and the Rab-saris and the Rabshakeh from Lachish to King Hezekiah, with a heavy army, [to] Jerusalem. And they went up and came to Jerusalem; and they went up and came and stood at the conduit of the upper pool, which [is] on the highway to the Fuller's Field.
en.B: Then the king of Assyria sent the commander-in-chief, the chief of the court officials and the chief officer from Lachish to King Hezekiah in Jerusalem, with a large army. They went up and came to Jerusalem. When they arrived, they took their stand by the water channel from the Upper Pool, which is on the road to the Fuller's Field.
en.R: The king of Assyria was at the city of Lachish. From there he sent three of his highest officials to King Hezekiah in Jerusalem with a large army. They were the commander of his army, the head of his palace officials and the Assyrian commander. They marched up to Jerusalem. When they got there, they stood by the water channel that comes from the Upper Pool. It is on the road to the field where cloth is washed.

es.L: Y el rey de Asiria envió desde Laquis al Tartán, al Rabsaris y al Rabsaces, con un ejército pesado, al rey Ezequías, [a] Jerusalén. Y subieron y llegaron a Jerusalén; y subieron y llegaron y se detuvieron junto al acueducto del estanque de arriba, que [está] en el camino del campo del Lavador.
es.B: Entonces el rey de Asiria envió desde Laquis al comandante en jefe, al jefe de los funcionarios de la corte y al copero mayor, con un gran ejército, al rey Ezequías en Jerusalén. Subieron y llegaron a Jerusalén. Cuando llegaron, se apostaron junto al canal del estanque de arriba, que está en el camino del campo del Lavador.
es.R: El rey de Asiria estaba en la ciudad de Laquis. Desde allí envió a tres de sus más altos funcionarios al rey Ezequías, en Jerusalén, con un gran ejército. Eran el comandante de su ejército, el jefe de los funcionarios de su palacio y el copero mayor. Subieron a Jerusalén. Cuando llegaron, se pararon junto al canal que viene del estanque de arriba. Está en el camino del campo donde se lava la ropa.

fr.L: Et le roi d’Assyrie envoya de Lakish le Tartan, le Rab-Saris et le Rabshaqé vers le roi Ézéchias, avec une armée nombreuse, [à] Jérusalem. Et ils montèrent et vinrent à Jérusalem ; et ils montèrent, vinrent et se tinrent près de l’aqueduc du réservoir supérieur, qui [est] sur la route du champ du Foulon.
fr.B: Le roi d’Assyrie envoya de Lakish au roi Ézéchias, à Jérusalem, le commandant en chef, le chef des hauts fonctionnaires et le grand échanson, avec une armée nombreuse. Ils montèrent et arrivèrent à Jérusalem. Une fois arrivés, ils prirent position près du canal du réservoir supérieur, qui est sur la route du champ du Foulon.
fr.R: Le roi d’Assyrie était dans la ville de Lakish. De là, il a envoyé trois de ses plus hauts responsables auprès du roi Ézéchias, à Jérusalem, avec une grande armée. C’étaient le chef de son armée, le chef des fonctionnaires du palais et le grand échanson. Ils sont montés jusqu’à Jérusalem. Quand ils sont arrivés, ils se sont arrêtés près du canal qui vient du réservoir supérieur. Il se trouve sur la route du champ où l’on lave les étoffes.

sw.L: Naye mfalme wa Ashuru akamtuma Tartani na Rab-sarisi na Rabshake kutoka Lakishi kwa mfalme Hezekia, pamoja na jeshi kubwa, [hata] Yerusalemu. Nao wakapanda, wakafika Yerusalemu; nao walipopanda na kufika, wakasimama karibu na mfereji wa bwawa la juu, ulio katika njia kuu ya Shamba la Dobi.
sw.B: Kisha mfalme wa Ashuru alimtuma jemadari mkuu, mkuu wa maafisa wa ikulu na Rabshake kutoka Lakishi kwa mfalme Hezekia huko Yerusalemu, pamoja na jeshi kubwa. Wakapanda, wakafika Yerusalemu. Walipofika, wakasimama karibu na mfereji wa maji wa Bwawa la Juu, ulio katika njia ya kwenda Shamba la Dobi.
sw.R: Mfalme wa Ashuru alikuwa katika mji wa Lakishi. Kutoka huko aliwatuma maafisa wake watatu wa ngazi ya juu kabisa kwa mfalme Hezekia huko Yerusalemu, pamoja na jeshi kubwa. Hao walikuwa jemadari wa jeshi lake, mkuu wa maafisa wa jumba lake, na Rabshake, kamanda wa Ashuru. Wakaenda Yerusalemu. Walipofika huko, wakasimama karibu na mfereji wa maji unaotoka katika Bwawa la Juu. Uko katika njia ya kwenda kwenye shamba ambapo nguo hufuliwa.

vi.L: Vua A-si-ri sai Tạt-tan, Ráp-sa-ri và Ráp-sa-kê từ La-ki đến vua Ê-xê-chia, cùng một đạo quân hùng hậu, [đến] Giê-ru-sa-lem. Họ đi lên và đến Giê-ru-sa-lem; họ đi lên, đến và đứng tại cống dẫn nước của hồ trên, ở bên đường cái đến Cánh Đồng Thợ Giặt.
vi.B: Bấy giờ vua A-si-ri sai quan tổng tư lệnh, quan trưởng triều thần và viên quan trưởng từ La-ki đến gặp vua Ê-xê-chia tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, cùng một đạo quân hùng hậu. Họ đi lên và đến Giê-ru-sa-lem. Khi đến nơi, họ dừng lại bên cống dẫn nước của Hồ Trên, ở bên đường đến Cánh Đồng Thợ Giặt.
vi.R: Vua A-si-ri đang ở thành La-ki. Từ đó vua sai ba quan chức cao cấp nhất của mình đến gặp vua Ê-xê-chia tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, cùng một đạo quân đông đảo. Đó là vị chỉ huy quân đội, người đứng đầu các quan trong cung và viên chỉ huy A-si-ri. Họ kéo lên Giê-ru-sa-lem. Khi đến nơi, họ đứng bên cống dẫn nước từ Hồ Trên. Cống ấy ở bên đường đến cánh đồng nơi người ta giặt vải.

ko.L: 그리고 앗시리아 왕이 라기스에서 다르단과 랍사리스와 랍사게를 큰 군대와 함께 예루살렘으로 히스기야 왕에게 보냈다. 그리고 그들이 올라가 예루살렘에 이르렀다. 그리고 그들이 올라가서 이르러, 세탁자의 밭으로 가는 큰길에 있는 윗못의 수로 곁에 섰다.
ko.B: 앗시리아 왕은 라기스에서 총사령관과 궁중 관리들의 우두머리와 랍사게를 큰 군대와 함께 예루살렘의 히스기야 왕에게 보냈다. 그들은 올라가 예루살렘에 이르렀다. 그들은 도착하여 세탁자의 밭으로 가는 길에 있는 윗못의 수로 곁에 진을 쳤다.
ko.R: 앗시리아 왕은 라기스 성에 있었다. 그는 거기에서 가장 높은 관리 세 사람을 큰 군대와 함께 예루살렘의 히스기야 왕에게 보냈다. 그들은 군대 사령관과 왕궁 관리들의 우두머리와 랍사게라고 불리는 고위 관리였다. 그들은 예루살렘으로 올라갔다. 거기에 이르러 그들은 윗못에서 흘러나오는 수로 곁에 섰다. 그곳은 천을 빨아 말리는 밭으로 가는 길가였다.

pt.L: E o rei da Assíria enviou o Tartã, e o Rabe-Sáris, e o Rabsaqué, de Laquis ao rei Ezequias, com um exército pesado, [a] Jerusalém. E subiram e vieram a Jerusalém; e subiram, e vieram, e pararam junto ao aqueduto do tanque superior, que [está] no caminho do campo do lavandeiro.
pt.B: Então o rei da Assíria enviou de Laquis o comandante-chefe, o chefe dos oficiais da corte e o oficial-chefe ao rei Ezequias, em Jerusalém, com um grande exército. Eles subiram e chegaram a Jerusalém. Quando chegaram, tomaram posição junto ao aqueduto do tanque superior, que fica no caminho do campo do lavandeiro.
pt.R: O rei da Assíria estava na cidade de Laquis. Dali ele enviou três dos seus oficiais mais importantes ao rei Ezequias, em Jerusalém, com um grande exército. Eram o comandante do seu exército, o chefe dos oficiais do seu palácio e o comandante assírio. Eles marcharam até Jerusalém. Quando chegaram lá, pararam junto ao canal que traz água do tanque superior. Ele fica no caminho do campo onde se lava roupa.

am.L: የአሦርም ንጉሥ ተርታንን፣ ራብሳሪስንና ራፋስቂስን ከለኪሶ ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ሕዝቅያስ ከከባድ ሠራዊት ጋር ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ላከ፤ ወጡም፤ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም መጡ፤ ወጥተውም መጡ፤ ወደ አጣቢው እርሻ በሚወስደው አውራ ጎዳና ላይ ባለው በላይኛው ኩሬ መስኖ አጠገብ ቆሙ።
am.B: ከዚያም የአሦር ንጉሥ ዋና የጦር አዛዡን ተርታንን፣ የቤተ መንግሥቱን ሹማምንት አለቃ ራብሳሪስንና የጦር መሪውን ራፋስቂስን ከብዙ ሠራዊት ጋር ከለኪሶ ወደ ንጉሥ ሕዝቅያስ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ላካቸው። ወጥተውም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጡ። በደረሱም ጊዜ ወደ አጣቢው እርሻ በሚወስደው አውራ ጎዳና ላይ ባለው በላይኛው ኩሬ መስኖ አጠገብ ቆሙ።
am.R: የአሦር ንጉሥ በለኪሶ ከተማ ነበረ። ከዚያም ሦስቱን ከፍተኛ ባለ ሥልጣኖቹን ከብዙ ሠራዊት ጋር በኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ነበረው ወደ ንጉሥ ሕዝቅያስ ላካቸው። እነርሱም የሠራዊቱ ዋና አዛዥ ተርታን፣ የቤተ መንግሥቱ ሹማምንት አለቃ ራብሳሪስና የጦር መሪው ራፋስቂስ ነበሩ። ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጥተው መጡ። በደረሱም ጊዜ ከላይኛው ኩሬ በሚመጣው የውኃ መስኖ አጠገብ ቆሙ። ይህም ልብስ አጣቢዎች ልብስ ወደሚያጥቡበት እርሻ በሚወስደው መንገድ ላይ ነው።

hi.L: और अश्शूर के राजा ने तर्तान और रबसारीस और रबशाके को लाकीश से राजा हिजकिय्याह के पास भारी सेना के साथ यरूशलेम [को] भेजा। और वे चढ़कर यरूशलेम आए; और वे चढ़कर आए और ऊपरी तालाब की नाली के पास, जो धोबी के खेत के राजमार्ग पर [है], खड़े हुए।
hi.B: तब अश्शूर के राजा ने अपने प्रधान सेनापति, दरबारियों के प्रधान और मुख्य अधिकारी को लाकीश से बड़ी सेना के साथ यरूशलेम में राजा हिजकिय्याह के पास भेजा। वे चढ़कर यरूशलेम आए। वहाँ पहुँचकर वे ऊपरी तालाब की नाली के पास खड़े हुए, जो धोबी के खेत की सड़क पर है।
hi.R: अश्शूर का राजा लाकीश नगर में था। वहाँ से उसने अपने तीन सबसे बड़े अधिकारियों को बड़ी सेना के साथ यरूशलेम में राजा हिजकिय्याह के पास भेजा। वे थे उसकी सेना का प्रधान, महल के अधिकारियों का प्रधान, और अश्शूरी सेनापति। वे यरूशलेम तक चढ़ आए। वहाँ पहुँचकर वे उस नाली के पास खड़े हुए जो ऊपरी तालाब से आती है। वह उस सड़क पर है जो उस खेत को जाती है जहाँ कपड़े धोए जाते हैं।

ru.L: И послал царь Ассирии тартана, и рабсариса, и рабсака из Лахиса к царю Езекии с тяжёлым войском [в] Иерусалим. И поднялись они и пришли в Иерусалим; и поднялись, и пришли, и стали у водовода верхнего пруда, что на дороге к полю белильщика.
ru.B: Тогда царь Ассирии послал из Лахиса к царю Езекии в Иерусалим главнокомандующего, начальника придворных и главного приближённого с большим войском. Они поднялись и пришли к Иерусалиму. Придя туда, они встали у водовода Верхнего пруда, что на дороге к полю белильщика.
ru.R: Царь Ассирии находился в городе Лахисе. Оттуда он послал к царю Езекии в Иерусалим трёх своих самых высоких приближённых с большим войском. Это были командующий его войском, начальник дворцовых слуг и ассирийский военачальник. Они пришли к Иерусалиму. Там они встали у водовода, который идёт от Верхнего пруда. Он находится у дороги к полю, где отбеливают ткани.

ja.L: そしてアッシリアの王は、タルタンとラブ・サリスとラブ・シャケを、大軍と共に、ラキシュからエルサレムのヒゼキヤ王のもとに遣わした。彼らは上って行き、エルサレムに来た。彼らは上って行き、来て、布さらしの野の大路にある、上の池の水道のそばに立った。
ja.B: そこでアッシリアの王は、総司令官と宮廷の役人の長と将軍を、大軍と共に、ラキシュからエルサレムのヒゼキヤ王のもとに遣わした。彼らは上って行き、エルサレムに来た。到着すると、彼らは布さらしの野へ行く大路にある、上の池の水路のそばに陣取った。
ja.R: アッシリアの王は、ラキシュの町にいました。王はそこから、最も地位の高い三人の役人を、大軍と共にエルサレムのヒゼキヤ王のもとに送りました。それは、軍の総司令官と、王宮の役人たちの長と、アッシリアの将軍でした。彼らはエルサレムに上って来ました。到着すると、上の池から流れる水路のそばに立ちました。そこは、布を洗ってさらす野原へ行く道の上にあります。

uk.L: І послав цар Ассирії Тартана, і Рав-Саріса, і Рав-Шаке з Лахіша до царя Єзекії з великим військом, [до] Єрусалима. І вони піднялися і прийшли до Єрусалима; і піднялися, і прийшли, і стали біля водогону верхнього ставу, що [на] дорозі до Поля Білильника.
uk.B: Тоді цар Ассирії послав з Лахіша головнокомандувача, начальника придворних і головного урядовця з великим військом до царя Єзекії в Єрусалим. Вони піднялися і прийшли до Єрусалима. Прийшовши, вони стали біля водогону з Верхнього ставу, що на дорозі до Поля Білильника.
uk.R: Цар Ассирії був у місті Лахіші. Звідти він послав трьох своїх найвищих урядовців з великим військом до царя Єзекії в Єрусалим. Це були командувач його війська, голова його палацових урядовців і ассирійський воєначальник. Вони пішли до Єрусалима. Коли вони прийшли туди, то стали біля водогону, що йде від Верхнього ставу. Він на дорозі до поля, де вибілюють тканини.

decisions.choice: the parallel in Isaiah 36:2
decisions.reason: Isaiah 36:2 has the king send only the Rabshakeh; Kings names three officers, the Tartan, the Rab-saris and the Rabshakeh, and so has plural verbs ("they went up ... they stood"). Kings also tells the arrival twice, "they went up and came", and adds "which is" before the road. The rest of the verse is the same.

decisions.choice: Tartan and Rab-saris: titles of high Assyrian officers, not names
decisions.reason: Both are titles borrowed from Assyrian. The Tartan was the highest officer under the king, the commander-in-chief of the army (Isaiah 20:1). The Rab-saris was the chief of the court officials; the second part of the title is the word used for eunuchs or court officials (Jeremiah 39:3 names a Babylonian Rab-saris).

decisions.choice: Rabshakeh: the title of a high Assyrian official, not a personal name
decisions.reason: The word is an Assyrian title, made of "chief" and an office usually taken to mean "cupbearer"; by this time it named one of the king's highest officers, able to lead troops and speak for the king. He is the one who speaks in verses 19-35. The text never gives his name.

decisions.choice: they went up and came, twice: the arrival told step by step
decisions.reason: The words "they went up and came" stand twice. The repetition slows the story as the army reaches the city. It may also have come about in copying, since some ancient Greek copies have the phrase only once; the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: the conduit of the upper pool: the place where Isaiah met Ahaz
decisions.reason: The officers stand at the very spot named in Isaiah 7:3, where Isaiah met King Ahaz and urged him to trust Yahweh instead of seeking help; Ahaz turned to Assyria (16:7). Now Assyria's officers stand there to demand that Hezekiah surrender.

decisions.choice: the Tartan, the Rab-saris, the Rabshakeh
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the three Assyrian titles as titles, with the article, as the Hebrew has them and as Isaiah 36:2 keeps "the Rabshakeh".

decisions.choice: the commander-in-chief, the chief of the court officials, the chief officer
decisions.reason: Balanced translates the titles instead of keeping them as strange names. The Tartan is called "the commander-in-chief" as in Isaiah 20:1, and the Rabshakeh "the chief officer" as in Isaiah 36.

decisions.choice: the commander of his army, the head of his palace officials, the Assyrian commander
decisions.reason: Readable names the officers by what they did. It calls the Rabshakeh "the Assyrian commander", as Isaiah 36 does, because he is the one who leads the talks and speaks for the king.

decisions.choice: The king of Assyria was at the city of Lachish. From there he sent ...
decisions.reason: Readable says first where the king was, then sends the officers, to keep the sentences short, as in Isaiah 36:2.

decisions.choice: "el Tartán, el Rabsaris, el Rabsaces" (L); "el comandante en jefe, el jefe de los funcionarios de la corte, el copero mayor" (B); "el comandante de su ejército, el jefe de los funcionarios de su palacio, el copero mayor" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the three Assyrian titles as titles, with the article. Balanced and Readable translate them; the Rabshakeh is "el copero mayor" at both, as the Kings and Chronicles terms note sets, kept through 18:17-19:8.

decisions.choice: "el estanque de arriba"; "el campo del Lavador" (L, B); "el campo donde se lava la ropa" (R)
decisions.reason: The places where Isaiah met Ahaz (Isaiah 7:3), in plain Spanish; Readable says what the Fuller's Field was.

decisions.choice: "le Tartan, le Rab-Saris, le Rabshaqé" (L); "le commandant en chef, le chef des hauts fonctionnaires, le grand échanson" (B); "le chef de son armée, le chef des fonctionnaires du palais, le grand échanson" (R)
decisions.reason: These are titles, not names (m2, m3). Literal keeps the Assyrian titles; Balanced and Readable translate them. The terms note sets "le grand échanson" for Rabshakeh, the literal sense of the title, where the English Readable says "the Assyrian commander"; *saris* is "haut fonctionnaire" as the note sets.

decisions.choice: Tartani, Rab-sarisi, Rabshake (Literal); jemadari mkuu, mkuu wa maafisa wa ikulu, Rabshake (Balanced); the same explained at Readable, with "Rabshake, kamanda wa Ashuru"
decisions.reason: The three are Assyrian titles (meaning decisions m2, m3). The terms note keeps "Rabshake" in Swahili at every level, so Balanced and Readable translate the other two titles but keep this one, and Readable says once who he was.

decisions.choice: Mfalme wa Ashuru alikuwa katika mji wa Lakishi. Kutoka huko ...
decisions.reason: Readable sets the scene first and splits the long sentence, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Tạt-tan, Ráp-sa-ri, Ráp-sa-kê (L); quan tổng tư lệnh, quan trưởng triều thần, viên quan trưởng (B); vị chỉ huy quân đội, người đứng đầu các quan trong cung, viên chỉ huy A-si-ri (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the three Assyrian titles as the Hebrew has them; Balanced and Readable translate them, using for the Rabshakeh the forms of the terms note ("viên quan trưởng", "viên chỉ huy A-si-ri"), kept through chapters 18-19.

decisions.choice: "다르단과 랍사리스와 랍사게" (L); "총사령관과 궁중 관리들의 우두머리와 랍사게" (B); R names "랍사게라고 불리는 고위 관리" and then says "랍사게"
decisions.reason: The terms note keeps "랍사게" for the Rabshakeh in Korean, the form readers know; the two other titles are translated at Balanced and Readable, and Readable says once that 랍사게 is a title of a high official.

decisions.choice: o Tartã, o Rabe-Sáris, o Rabsaqué (L); o comandante-chefe, o chefe dos oficiais da corte, o oficial-chefe (B); o comandante do seu exército, o chefe dos oficiais do seu palácio, o comandante assírio (R)
alternatives: Tartã, Rabe-Sáris and Rabsaqué as names at every level
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also chapter 19): the three Assyrian titles (m2, m3) are kept as titles with the article at Literal, as the English Literal keeps them, in Portuguese spellings: "Tartã" with the nasal ending for "-an", "Rabe-Sáris" with the "-e" Portuguese adds after a consonant, and "Rabsaqué", the form of the shared list for Kings. Balanced translates the titles and Readable names the officers by what they did, as the English does, so through the chapter the speaker is "o Rabsaqué" (L), "o oficial-chefe" (B) and "o comandante assírio" (R).

decisions.choice: o aqueduto do tanque superior, no caminho do campo do lavandeiro (L, B); o canal que traz água do tanque superior ... o campo onde se lava roupa (R)
alternatives: o canal do açude de cima
decisions.reason: The place (m5) is worded so that Isaiah 7:3, where the same place is named, can be given the same words in Portuguese: "aqueduto" for the channel, "tanque" for the pool, as in 2 Samuel 2:13, and "o campo do lavandeiro", the field where cloth was washed. Readable says plainly what each was, as the English does.

decisions.choice: The three Assyrian titles are kept as names, "ተርታን", "ራብሳሪስ" and "ራፋስቂስ", at every level; Balanced and Readable say at this first mention what each office was ("ዋና የጦር አዛዥ", "የቤተ መንግሥቱ ሹማምንት አለቃ", "የጦር መሪ").
alternatives: translating the titles throughout, as the English Balanced and Readable do
decisions.reason: The terms list gives "ራፋስቂስ" for the Rabshakeh, the form Amharic readers know from this story; keeping the three titles as names and explaining them once lets the long speech name its speaker plainly, as the Hebrew does, and Isaiah 36 will follow.

decisions.choice: "የላይኛው ኩሬ መስኖ" for the conduit of the upper pool; "የአጣቢው እርሻ" for the Fuller's Field (R explains).
decisions.reason: The place where Isaiah met Ahaz (m5, Isaiah 7:3), so the wording is set for Isaiah too.

decisions.choice: the titles: "तर्तान", "रबसारीस", "रबशाके" (L); "प्रधान सेनापति", "दरबारियों का प्रधान", "मुख्य अधिकारी" (B); "सेना का प्रधान", "महल के अधिकारियों का प्रधान", "अश्शूरी सेनापति" (R)
alternatives: "रबशाके" as a name at every level
decisions.reason: These are Assyrian titles, not names. Literal transcribes them, as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable translate them, keeping one Hindi title for the Rabshakeh at each level through chapters 18-19.

decisions.choice: тартан, рабсарис, рабсак (L); главнокомандующий, начальник придворных, главный приближённый (B); командующий войском, начальник дворцовых слуг, ассирийский военачальник (R)
decisions.reason: These are titles of Assyrian officers, not personal names (m2, m3); Literal transcribes them in lower case as titles, and Balanced and Readable say what each office was, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Titles kept as transcriptions at L: "タルタン", "ラブ・サリス", "ラブ・シャケ"
decisions.reason: As the English Literal; they are titles, not names (see the footnote).

decisions.choice: "総司令官" / "宮廷の役人の長" / "将軍" (B); "軍の総司令官" / "王宮の役人たちの長" / "アッシリアの将軍" (R)
decisions.reason: The Rabshakeh acts as the army's spokesman in the field, so "将軍" names his role; a literal "chief cupbearer" would mislead. Kept for Isaiah 36-37.

decisions.choice: The three Assyrian titles as names at Literal ("Тартан", "Рав-Саріс", "Рав-Шаке"), as offices at Balanced ("головнокомандувач", "начальник придворних", "головний урядовець") and Readable ("командувач його війська", "голова його палацових урядовців", "ассирійський воєначальник")
decisions.reason: The English Literal keeps the titles as the Hebrew has them and the other levels say what each officer was; Ukrainian follows, and later in the chapter each level keeps its own form for the spokesman.

source.text: וַֽיִּקְרְאוּ֙ אֶל־הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיֵּצֵ֧א אֲלֵהֶ֛ם אֶלְיָקִ֥ים בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּ֖הוּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הַבָּ֑יִת וְשֶׁבְנָה֙ הַסֹּפֵ֔ר וְיוֹאָ֥ח בֶּן־אָסָ֖ף הַמַּזְכִּֽיר׃

records.literal_gloss: And they called to the king, and went out to them Eliakim son of Hilkiah who [was] over the house, and Shebnah the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder.

en.L: And they called to the king, and Eliakim son of Hilkiah, who [was] over the house, went out to them, and Shebna the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder.
en.B: They called for the king, and Eliakim son of Hilkiah, who was in charge of the palace, went out to them, together with Shebna the secretary and Joah son of Asaph, the recorder.
en.R: They called for the king to come out. Instead, three of Hezekiah's officials went out to meet them. They were Eliakim son of Hilkiah, who was in charge of the king's palace, Shebna, the royal secretary, and Joah son of Asaph, who kept the records.

es.L: Y llamaron al rey, y salió a ellos Eliaquim hijo de Hilcías, que [estaba] sobre la casa, y Sebna el secretario, y Joa hijo de Asaf, el cronista.
es.B: Llamaron al rey, y salieron a su encuentro Eliaquim hijo de Hilcías, el mayordomo del palacio, junto con Sebna el secretario y Joa hijo de Asaf, el cronista.
es.R: Pidieron que el rey saliera. En su lugar salieron a recibirlos tres funcionarios de Ezequías. Eran Eliaquim hijo de Hilcías, el mayordomo del palacio real; Sebna, el secretario del rey; y Joa hijo de Asaf, que llevaba el registro de los hechos del reino.

fr.L: Et ils appelèrent le roi, et Éliaqim fils de Hilqiya, qui [était] le chef du palais, sortit vers eux, ainsi que Shebna le secrétaire et Yoah fils d’Asaph, l’archiviste.
fr.B: Ils appelèrent le roi, et Éliaqim, fils de Hilqiya, le chef du palais, sortit vers eux, avec Shebna, le secrétaire, et Yoah, fils d’Asaph, l’archiviste.
fr.R: Ils ont demandé que le roi vienne leur parler. Mais ce sont trois responsables d’Ézéchias qui sont sortis à leur rencontre : Éliaqim fils de Hilqiya, qui dirigeait le palais du roi, Shebna, le secrétaire du roi, et Yoah fils d’Asaph, qui tenait les archives.

sw.L: Nao walipomwita mfalme, Eliakimu mwana wa Hilkia, aliyekuwa msimamizi wa ikulu, akatoka kwenda kwao, na Shebna katibu, na Yoa mwana wa Asafu mwandishi wa kumbukumbu.
sw.B: Walimwita mfalme, naye Eliakimu mwana wa Hilkia, msimamizi wa ikulu, akatoka kwenda kwao, pamoja na Shebna katibu na Yoa mwana wa Asafu, mwandishi wa kumbukumbu.
sw.R: Walimwita mfalme atoke nje. Badala yake maafisa watatu wa Hezekia walitoka kwenda kukutana nao. Walikuwa Eliakimu mwana wa Hilkia, msimamizi wa jumba la mfalme, Shebna, katibu wa mfalme, na Yoa mwana wa Asafu, aliyetunza kumbukumbu.

vi.L: Họ gọi vua, và Ê-li-a-kim con trai Hinh-kia, quan cai quản cung điện, đi ra gặp họ, cùng Sép-na thư ký và Giô-a con trai A-sáp sử quan.
vi.B: Họ gọi vua ra, và Ê-li-a-kim con trai Hinh-kia, quan cai quản cung điện, đi ra gặp họ, cùng với Sép-na thư ký và Giô-a con trai A-sáp, sử quan.
vi.R: Họ đòi vua ra gặp. Nhưng ba quan chức của Ê-xê-chia đi ra gặp họ. Đó là Ê-li-a-kim con trai Hinh-kia, quan cai quản cung điện, Sép-na, thư ký của vua, và Giô-a con trai A-sáp, người giữ sổ sách của triều đình.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 왕을 불렀다. 그러자 궁내 대신인 힐기야의 아들 엘리아김과 서기관 셉나와 사관인 아삽의 아들 요아가 그들에게 나갔다.
ko.B: 그들이 왕을 불러내자, 궁내 대신인 힐기야의 아들 엘리아김과 서기관 셉나와 사관인 아삽의 아들 요아가 그들에게 나갔다.
ko.R: 그들은 왕에게 나오라고 소리쳤다. 그러나 왕 대신에 히스기야의 관리 세 사람이 그들을 만나러 나갔다. 그들은 왕궁 일을 맡은 힐기야의 아들 엘리아김과, 왕의 서기관 셉나와, 기록을 맡은 아삽의 아들 요아였다.

pt.L: E chamaram o rei, e saíram até eles Eliaquim, filho de Hilquias, que [estava] sobre a casa, e Sebna, o escrivão, e Joá, filho de Asafe, o cronista.
pt.B: Eles chamaram o rei, e Eliaquim, filho de Hilquias, o encarregado do palácio, saiu até eles, junto com Sebna, o secretário, e Joá, filho de Asafe, o arquivista do reino.
pt.R: Eles chamaram o rei para que viesse falar com eles. Em vez dele, três oficiais de Ezequias saíram ao encontro deles. Eram Eliaquim, filho de Hilquias, que administrava o palácio do rei, Sebna, o secretário do rei, e Joá, filho de Asafe, que cuidava dos registros oficiais.

am.L: ወደ ንጉሡም ተጣሩ፤ በቤቱም ላይ የነበረው የኬልቅያስ ልጅ ኤልያቄም፣ ጸሐፊውም ሼብና፣ ታሪክ ጸሐፊውም የአሳፍ ልጅ ዮአሕ ወደ እነርሱ ወጡ።
am.B: ንጉሡን ጠሩት፤ የቤተ መንግሥቱም አስተዳዳሪ የኬልቅያስ ልጅ ኤልያቄም፣ ጸሐፊው ሼብናና ታሪክ ጸሐፊው የአሳፍ ልጅ ዮአሕ ወደ እነርሱ ወጡ።
am.R: ንጉሡ ወጥቶ እንዲያነጋግራቸው ጠሩት። በእርሱ ፋንታ ግን ሦስቱ የሕዝቅያስ ሹማምንት ሊያገኟቸው ወጡ። እነርሱም የቤተ መንግሥቱ አስተዳዳሪ የኬልቅያስ ልጅ ኤልያቄም፣ የንጉሡ ጸሐፊ ሼብናና የቤተ መንግሥቱን መዝገብ የሚይዘው የአሳፍ ልጅ ዮአሕ ነበሩ።

hi.L: और उन्होंने राजा को पुकारा, और हिल्किय्याह का पुत्र इल्याकीम, जो घराने पर [अधिकारी था], और शेबना मंत्री, और आसाप का पुत्र योआह इतिहास-लेखक उनके पास बाहर निकले।
hi.B: उन्होंने राजा को बुलवाया। तब हिल्किय्याह का पुत्र इल्याकीम, जो राजमहल का अधिकारी था, शेबना मंत्री और आसाप का पुत्र योआह इतिहास-लेखक उनके पास बाहर आए।
hi.R: उन्होंने राजा को बाहर आने के लिए पुकारा। पर राजा के बदले उसके तीन अधिकारी उनसे मिलने बाहर गए। वे थे हिल्किय्याह का बेटा इल्याकीम, जो राजमहल का अधिकारी था, शेबना, जो राजा का मंत्री था, और आसाप का बेटा योआह, जो राज्य का लेखा-जोखा रखता था।

ru.L: И позвали они царя, и вышел к ним Елиаким, сын Хелкии, который [был] над домом, и Севна, писец, и Иоах, сын Асафа, летописец.
ru.B: Они вызвали царя, и к ним вышли Елиаким, сын Хелкии, управляющий дворцом, писец Севна и летописец Иоах, сын Асафа.
ru.R: Они потребовали, чтобы царь вышел к ним. Вместо него к ним вышли три приближённых Езекии. Это были Елиаким, сын Хелкии, управляющий царским дворцом, Севна, царский писец, и Иоах, сын Асафа, который вёл летопись.

ja.L: そして彼らは王を呼んだ。すると、宮廷の長であるヒルキヤの子エルヤキムと、書記シェブナと、記録官であるアサフの子ヨアが、彼らのところに出て来た。
ja.B: 彼らが王を呼び出すと、宮廷の長であるヒルキヤの子エルヤキムが、書記シェブナ、記録官であるアサフの子ヨアと共に、彼らのところに出て来た。
ja.R: 彼らは、王に出て来るよう呼びかけました。けれども、王の代わりに、ヒゼキヤの三人の役人が会いに出て来ました。それは、王宮を任されていたヒルキヤの息子エルヤキムと、王の書記シェブナと、記録係であるアサフの息子ヨアでした。

uk.L: І покликали вони царя, і вийшов до них Еліяким, син Хілкії, що [був] над домом, і Шевна, писар, і Йоах, син Асафа, літописець.
uk.B: Вони викликали царя, і до них вийшов Еліяким, син Хілкії, управитель палацу, разом із Шевною, писарем, і Йоахом, сином Асафа, літописцем.
uk.R: Вони покликали царя, щоб той вийшов. Натомість до них вийшли троє урядовців Єзекії. Це були Еліяким, син Хілкії, що керував царським палацом, Шевна, царський писар, і Йоах, син Асафа, що вів державні записи.

decisions.choice: the parallel in Isaiah 36:3
decisions.reason: Kings adds that the Assyrians first called for the king, and has "to them" where Isaiah has "to him". Hezekiah does not go out himself; he sends three officials in his place. The rest is the same.

decisions.choice: Eliakim over the house, Shebna the secretary
decisions.reason: In Isaiah 22:15-25 Shebna was over the house, and Yahweh said that Eliakim son of Hilkiah would take his post. Here Eliakim holds that office and Shebna serves as secretary.

decisions.choice: secretary and recorder: senior royal officials
decisions.reason: The secretary handled the king's letters and records of state; the recorder (literally "one who causes to remember") kept official records and perhaps announced the king's decisions. Both offices appear among David's officials (2 Samuel 8:16-17).

decisions.choice: Shebna: one man, whose name is spelled two ways
decisions.reason: Here and in verse 26 the name ends in a different letter from verse 37 and Isaiah 36. The spelling differs, but it is the same man and the same name.

decisions.choice: Shebna
decisions.reason: Every level spells the name as in verse 37 and Isaiah 36, so that one man has one name.

decisions.choice: Eliaquim, filho de Hilquias; Sebna; Joá, filho de Asafe; [estava] sobre a casa (L), o encarregado do palácio (B), administrava o palácio (R); o escrivão (L), o secretário (B, R); o cronista (L), o arquivista do reino (B), cuidava dos registros oficiais (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also verses 26, 37; 19:2): the officials take their usual Brazilian forms, "Eliaquim", "Hilquias", "Sebna" (one spelling for both Hebrew spellings, m4), "Joá" and "Asafe". Their offices (m3) keep the words 1 Kings 4:3, 4:6 and 18:3 give them in Portuguese at each level.

decisions.choice: "የኬልቅያስ ልጅ ኤልያቄም", "ሼብና", "የአሳፍ ልጅ ዮአሕ"; "over the house" is "በቤቱ ላይ የነበረው" (L), "የቤተ መንግሥቱ አስተዳዳሪ" (B, R); secretary "ጸሐፊ", recorder "ታሪክ ጸሐፊ" (L, B), as 2 Samuel 20:24-25.
